scenario: AITA for Getting Mad Over a Rock? | I went for a hike in a wildlife/nature preserve with my husband. We were admiring various rocks along the way. He was being stealthy about it, carrying it alongside his body in such a way as to hide it from the caretaker of the preserve, who we passed on the way out, so he knew it wasn't something he should do openly.
